sections.name: Hero Section
sections.description: Dark forest photo background with navy overlay (#0B1220/80). Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal animation. Eyebrow tag: 'THE NEXT EVOLUTION OF ESG EDUCATION'. Headline with highlighted green word ('Master ESG Skills Through Guided Simulations'). Two CTAs: 'Join Simulation Waitlist' (green pill) & 'Explore Materials' (ghost).

sections.name: Our Vision Manifesto
sections.description: Dark navy (#0B1220) section with 3 numbered manifesto chapters: 01 Concrete, 02 Active, 03 Actionable. Highlight how simulation beats static PDFs. Prominent 'Get Early Access' waitlist form embedded.

sections.name: Why Choose Us
sections.description: 4-card bento grid with soft shadows on light grey background (#F6F8F7). Cards: 1. Real-World Carbon Audits, 2. Regulatory Compliance (CSRD/GRI), 3. Instant Performance Analytics, 4. Scalable B2B LMS Modules.

sections.name: Designed for Those Who Lead Change
sections.description: Audience selector & pull quote with executive office photo. Highlighting L&D Leaders, Corporate Sustainability Officers, University Lecturers.

sections.name: See It In Action (Before vs After)
sections.description: Interactive slider/toggle showing 'Old Way: 60-slide static PPT (12% retention)' vs 'Green Mind Way: 15-min Interactive Carbon Audit Simulation (89% retention)'. Marked with 'Coming Soon'.

sections.name: Diverse Learning Formats
sections.description: Icon row of formats: Interactive Simulations, SCORM Packages, Micro-learning Cards, Case Study Workshops, Video Explainers.

sections.name: Explore the Knowledge Hub
sections.description: Dark navy section with 4 topic tiles: Carbon Accounting, CSRD Readiness, Supply Chain ESG, Biodiversity Risk Assessment.

sections.name: How It All Connects
sections.description: 4-step timeline strip: 1. Assess Skill Gaps -> 2. Deploy Simulations -> 3. Track Learner Audit Reports -> 4. Certify Competency.

sections.name: eLearning Services Teaser
sections.description: 3 compact cards linking to B2B Services: PPT-to-eLearning Conversion, eLearning Troubleshooting & Fixes, LMS Integration.

sections.name: Proof & Metric Strip
sections.description: High impact counter strip: 500+ Certified Trainers | 50,000+ Learners Trained | 24% Average Score Improvement | 98% Completion Rate.

sections.name: Final CTA Banner
sections.description: Dark navy container with green CTA button and email newsletter input for early access.

simulations.description: Flagship 'Coming Soon' vision page. Hero showcasing interactive simulation preview mockups. Includes: Concept preview cards (Corporate Scope 3 Audit Simulator, ESG Board Presentation Lab, CSRD Compliance Trial), early access waitlist form, feature teardown, and FAQ.

learning_materials.description: Filterable library grid with sidebar controls (Topic: Carbon, CSRD, GRI; Format: SCORM, Workbooks, Quiz, Slides; Level: Beginner, Executive). Cards feature progress badges, download CTAs, and preview modals.

resources_hub.description: Tabs bar (Articles, Whitepapers, Case Studies, Checklists). Feature grid with search filter and downloadable PDF preview cards.

for_trainers.description: Tailored landing page for corporate & independent trainers. Highlights course delivery toolkits, slide decks, facilitator guides, and SCORM export options.

for_enterprise.description: Targeted page for HR, L&D, and CSOs. Features team seat management specs, custom branding, enterprise SSO/LMS integration, and ROI calculator snippet.

elearning_services.description: Deep-dive page for 3 core B2B services: (1) PPT-to-eLearning Conversion, (2) eLearning Troubleshooting & Fixes, (3) LMS Integration & Implementation. Features process steps, before/after examples, and consultation request form.

pricing.description: 3 tier pricing cards (Trainer, Team, Enterprise) with Monthly / Yearly toggle (20% discount badge). Full comparison matrix table below, and expandable FAQ accordion.

about_contact.description: Combined mission & contact page. Split contact layout: Dark navy left panel with office info, email, direct lines, and founder's note; White right panel with interactive contact & demo request form.

not_found.description: Custom 404 page styled with green leaf graphic, helpful quick links, and a search input.

motion_and_effects.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll integration for weighted momentum
motion_and_effects.framer_motion: Page transitions, scroll-triggered fade-in-up animations for cards, and masked line-by-line hero headline text reveals
motion_and_effects.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for client trust & partner logos: 'ISO 14001 • CSRD READY • GRI ALIGNED • SCORM 2004 • SEC COMPLIANT'
motion_and_effects.interactive: Before/After interactive comparison toggle, pricing monthly/annual toggle, filter search, contact submission feedback states

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, links, toggles, form submits) MUST have clear kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-simulations-link', data-testid='pricing-toggle-annual', data-testid='waitlist-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-page React router setup for all specified 9 pages + 404.
Follow the exact color palette: Primary BG (#FFFFFF), Secondary BG (#F6F8F7), Dark Navy bands (#0B1220), Forest Green accent (#1E8E4A).
Ensure all waitlist and contact forms display interactive success messages upon submission.
Implement the global header with sticky glassmorphism and the interactive search modal.
Implement all 'Coming Soon' badges on simulation features prominently.
Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and Lenis for smooth scrolling.
Ensure data-testid attributes are present on every interactive element.
